휴가.forms: 휴가가 · 휴가를 · 휴가를 가다 (go on vacation)
휴가.x: I'm going on vacation this summer.
휴가.t: 휴가 is time off from work or the military; for school breaks use 방학.

돼지고기.x: I put pork in kimchi stew.

셔츠.ex: 회사에 갈 때 하얀 셔츠를 입어요.
셔츠.x: I wear a white shirt when I go to work.
셔츠.e: From English 'shirt'. Usually means a button-up; a tee is 티셔츠.

단어.ex: 매일 새 단어를 열 개씩 외워요.
단어.x: I memorize ten new words every day.
단어.e: Literally 'single word'. 단어를 외우다 = memorize words.

자리.e: 자리 있어요? = Is this seat taken? Also means a position or job opening.

기다리다.x: I waited for the bus for thirty minutes.
기다리다.e: 잠깐만 기다리세요 = Please wait a moment.
기다리다.t: The person or thing waited for takes 을/를: 버스를 기다려요 = I'm waiting for the bus.

돌아가다.x: I'll go back to my hometown during the vacation.
돌아가다.t: 돌아가시다 (honorific) also politely means 'to pass away'.

졸다.forms: 졸아요 · 졸았어요 · 졸 거예요 · 조는 (+noun) (ㄹ drops)
졸다.x: I dozed off in class and got scolded by the teacher.
졸다.e: The root of 졸리다 (sleepy) and 졸음 (drowsiness).
졸다.t: Homonym: 졸다 also means 'to boil down,' as when soup reduces on the stove.

걸다.forms: 걸어요 · 걸었어요 · 걸 거예요 · 거세요 (ㄹ drops)
걸다.m: to hang; to make (a phone call)
걸다.ex: 이사한 후에 거실 벽에 예쁜 그림을 걸었어요.
걸다.x: After moving, I hung a pretty picture on the living room wall.
걸다.t: Also for calls: 전화를 걸다 = to make a phone call.

이틀.ex: 감기 때문에 이틀 동안 학교에 못 갔어요.
이틀.x: I couldn't go to school for two days because of a cold.
이틀.e: Native day count: 하루 (1), 이틀 (2), 사흘 (3), 나흘 (4).

치아.ex: 치아 건강을 위해 하루에 세 번 이를 닦으세요.
치아.x: Brush your teeth three times a day for healthy teeth.
치아.e: Literally 'tooth-tooth'; a formal word for teeth.
치아.t: 치아 is formal or medical; in daily speech say 이, as in 이를 닦다.

예의 바르다.forms: 예의 발라요 · 예의 발랐어요 · 예의 바른 (+noun) (르 irregular)
예의 바르다.ex: 그 학생은 항상 예의 바르게 인사해요.
예의 바르다.x: That student always greets people politely.
예의 바르다.e: 예의 'courtesy' + 바르다 'straight, proper': manners kept straight.
예의 바르다.t: The opposite is 예의 없다 or 버릇없다 (rude, spoiled), often said about children.

차이.x: The cultural differences between the two countries are big.
차이.e: Both syllables mean 'differ', doubled for emphasis.

무대.ex: 가수가 무대에 올라가자 사람들이 소리를 질렀어요.
무대.x: As soon as the singer went up on stage, people screamed.
무대.t: 무대에 서다 'to stand on stage' is the common way to say 'to perform.'

친해지다.m: to become close, to make friends
친해지다.ex: 같이 여행을 가서 그 친구와 친해졌어요.
친해지다.x: I got close with that friend after we traveled together.

판단하다.ex: 사람을 겉모습만 보고 판단하면 안 돼요.
판단하다.x: You shouldn't judge people only by their appearance.

단체.x: We went on a field trip to the museum as a group.

한편.forms: 한편이 · 한편을; 한편(으로는) (meanwhile, on the other hand)
한편.m: one side; meanwhile, on the other hand
한편.ex: 서울은 맑습니다. 한편 부산에는 비가 내리고 있습니다.
한편.x: It's clear in Seoul. Meanwhile, it's raining in Busan.
한편.e: 한 'one' + 편 'side': one side, then the other.
한편.t: News anchors use 한편 to switch topics, like 'Meanwhile, ...' in English.

뿐만 아니라.ex: 그 식당은 맛있을 뿐만 아니라 값도 싸요.
뿐만 아니라.x: That restaurant is not only tasty but also cheap.
뿐만 아니라.e: 뿐 'only' + 만 'just' + 아니라 'it is not': it's not just that.

갖추다.m: to have, to possess, to be equipped with; to prepare
갖추다.ex: 이 호텔은 좋은 시설을 갖추고 있어요.
갖추다.e: Probably related to 갖다 'to have': having everything needed in place.
갖추다.t: Common collocations: 자격을 갖추다 'to be qualified', 시설을 갖추다 'to be equipped'.

선발.x: This year's player selection was carried out fairly.
선발.t: 선발 is for selecting people such as players or students; for things, use 선택.

참고하다.x: Write your report using this book as a reference.

분기.e: Literally 'divided period' — the year split into four parts.

휴관.m: closure (of a museum, library, etc.), closed day
휴관.x: The museum is closed every Monday.
휴관.e: Literally 'the hall rests'; for shops, the word is 휴무 or 휴업.

해변.x: I swam at the beach with my friends in the summer.
해변.t: 바닷가 is the everyday native word; 해변 sounds a bit more formal or descriptive.

첫사랑.x: They say you remember your first love for a long time.
첫사랑.e: 첫 'first' + 사랑 'love'; 첫 also appears in 첫날 'first day' and 첫눈 'first snow'.
첫사랑.t: Pronounced [첟싸랑]: the ㅅ becomes tense after 첫.

분담하다.m: to share (work, costs), to divide up
분담하다.x: Our family shares the housework fairly.
분담하다.e: Literally 'divide and carry' — everyone takes part of the load.

탄수화물.ex: 밥과 빵에는 탄수화물이 많이 들어 있어요.
탄수화물.x: Rice and bread contain a lot of carbohydrates.
탄수화물.e: Literally 'carbon-water compound' — a direct translation of 'carbohydrate.'

학습자.ex: 이 앱은 초급 학습자에게 특히 도움이 돼요.
학습자.x: This app is especially helpful for beginner learners.
학습자.e: -자 = person who does it: 학습자, 연구자, 교육자.

천연자원.ex: 이 나라는 천연자원이 풍부해서 수출을 많이 해요.
천연자원.x: This country is rich in natural resources, so it exports a lot.

만료되다.m: to expire, to run out (a term or contract)
만료되다.ex: 여권이 다음 달에 만료돼서 새로 만들어야 해요.
만료되다.x: My passport expires next month, so I have to get a new one.
만료되다.e: Literally 'full and finished': the term has run its course.
만료되다.t: Pronounced [말료되다] — liquidization; used for contracts, visas and passports, not food (food uses 유통 기한이 지나다).

절감하다.ex: 새 기계 덕분에 비용을 크게 절감했어요.
절감하다.x: Thanks to the new machine, we cut costs a lot.

참신하다.x: That ad's idea is really fresh.

하필.forms: 하필 + time/thing: 하필 오늘 · emphatic: 하필이면 (왜 저예요?)
하필.ex: 소풍 가는 날 하필 비가 왔어요.
하필.x: Of all days, it rained on the day of the picnic.
하필.t: Complains about bad luck or timing. 하필이면 is more emphatic: 하필이면 왜 저예요? 'Why me, of all people?'

유동성.x: The central bank supplied liquidity to the market.
유동성.e: Literally 'flowing-moving quality' — how easily money or assets move.

시세.x: The market price of gold has risen a lot lately.
시세.e: Literally 'trend of the times' — what something sells for right now.

치부하다.m: to regard (as), to write off as, to dismiss as
치부하다.ex: 그들은 내 의견을 단순한 불평으로 치부했어요.
치부하다.x: They dismissed my opinion as mere complaining.
치부하다.e: Originally 'to enter in a ledger', so to mentally file something under a label.
치부하다.t: Usually negative: A를 B로 치부하다 = to brush A off as B.

비협조적.ex: 그는 조사에 계속 비협조적인 태도를 보였습니다.
비협조적.x: He kept showing an uncooperative attitude toward the investigation.
비협조적.e: 비- = 'non-, un-': a reusable prefix, e.g. 비협조적, 비공식, 비정상.

재차.m: again, a second time, once more
재차.x: The government once again urged citizens to stay safe.

하는 수 없이.ex: 표가 매진되어서 하는 수 없이 집에 돌아왔어요.
하는 수 없이.x: The tickets were sold out, so I had no choice but to go home.

인산인해.m: a sea of people; huge crowds
인산인해.x: During the festival, the streets are packed with huge crowds.

방방곡곡.m: every corner of the country; far and wide
방방곡곡.x: The news spread to every corner of the country.

일환.m: part, one part (of a larger plan)
일환.ex: 이 행사는 환경 보호 캠페인의 일환으로 열렸어요.
일환.x: This event was held as part of an environmental protection campaign.
일환.t: Almost always used in the pattern ~의 일환으로 (as part of ~).

임기.x: The Korean president's term of office is five years.
임기.t: Common collocations: 임기를 마치다 (finish one's term) and 임기 중에 (during one's term).

설교.ex: 오늘 목사님의 설교는 감사에 관한 내용이었어요.
설교.x: Today the pastor's sermon was about gratitude.
설교.t: Like English 'preach', it can mean a boring moral lecture: 설교 좀 그만해 = Stop lecturing me.

삼수.m: third attempt at the college entrance exam (after failing twice)
삼수.ex: 그는 삼수 끝에 원하는 대학에 합격했어요.
삼수.x: He got into the college he wanted after his third try at the entrance exam.
삼수.e: Literally 'third study'; the second attempt is 재수.
삼수.t: Also used as a verb: 삼수하다, 'to take the entrance exam a third time'.

만회하다.m: to make up for, to recover, to retrieve (a loss or setback)
만회하다.ex: 그는 지난번 실수를 만회하려고 더 열심히 일했어요.
만회하다.x: He worked harder to make up for his last mistake.
만회하다.e: Literally 'pull back' — pulling a bad situation back to where it was.
만회하다.t: Typical objects: 실수, 손실, 점수 — e.g. 한 점을 만회하다 (pull back a point).

꿀잼.x: The movie I saw yesterday was so much fun.
꿀잼.t: Casual/online, usually as 꿀잼이에요. The opposite is 노잼 'boring, no fun'.

위험자산.x: When the economy improves, investors flock to risk assets.
위험자산.e: Literally 'dangerous assets' — like stocks, whose value can swing widely.

초월.ex: 많은 종교는 시간과 공간의 초월을 이야기해요.
초월.x: Many religions speak of transcending time and space.
초월.t: Most common as a verb: 상상을 초월하다 (to be beyond imagination).

심사위원.ex: 심사위원들이 제 논문에 좋은 점수를 주었어요.
심사위원.x: The reviewers gave my paper a good score.
심사위원.t: Also used for judges in contests and TV auditions, not just academic reviewers.

게놈.x: The Human Genome Project was completed in 2003.
게놈.e: From German 'Genom'; the Sino-Korean term is 유전체.

부럼.m: nuts cracked on Jeongwol Daeboreum (walnuts, peanuts, chestnuts, etc.)
부럼.x: On the morning of Daeboreum, I cracked walnuts with my teeth as bureom.
부럼.e: Cracking these nuts was believed to prevent 부스럼 (skin boils) all year.
부럼.t: The set phrase is 부럼을 깨다 or 부럼을 깨물다.

어필하다.m: to appeal (to), to attract; to make one's case
어필하다.ex: 이 광고는 젊은 층에게 어필하고 있어요.
어필하다.x: This ad appeals to young people.
어필하다.e: From English 'appeal.' Mostly means 'to attract' or 'to show off one's strengths.'
어필하다.t: 자신을 어필하다 means to sell yourself, as in a job interview.

무도하다.x: The people were outraged by the king's wicked conduct.
무도하다.e: Literally 'without the Way' — lacking all morality.

고로.ex: 모든 사람은 죽습니다. 고로 소크라테스도 죽습니다.
고로.x: All men are mortal. Therefore, Socrates is mortal too.
고로.t: Famous line: 나는 생각한다, 고로 존재한다 'I think, therefore I am'.

국민청원.ex: 그 국민청원은 한 달 만에 이십만 명의 동의를 받았어요.
국민청원.x: That public petition got 200,000 signatures in a month.
국민청원.e: Literally 'the people's petition'; known from Korea's online presidential petition site.
국민청원.t: Pronounced [궁민청원]: ㄱ before ㅁ becomes ㅇ (nasalization).

구사하다.m: to use skillfully, to command (a language or technique)
구사하다.x: She speaks English and Chinese fluently.
구사하다.e: Literally 'drive and employ': wielding a skill as if commanding it.

분열하다.m: to split, to divide; to break up (a group)
분열하다.ex: 당 내부 갈등으로 조직이 둘로 분열했어요.
분열하다.x: Due to internal conflict, the organization split in two.
분열하다.t: Pronounced [부녈하다] — the batchim ㄴ links to the next vowel.

연마하다.m: to hone, to polish, to cultivate (a skill)
연마하다.ex: 그는 매일 몇 시간씩 기술을 연마했어요.
연마하다.x: He honed his skills for several hours every day.
연마하다.e: Literally 'grind and polish', like sharpening a blade.

이완되다.m: to relax, to loosen, to become slack
이완되다.x: Your muscles relax when you get into warm water.
이완되다.e: Literally 'loosen and slacken' — muscles, discipline or tension letting go.
